composition.uncertainty_statement: model score is uncalibrated and must not be read as a probability; frozen model cohort evidence: the frozen LightGBM policy gave the production document features no split and no gain, so the document-plus-market and market-only arms are prediction-equivalent (not validated at this sample size); frozen model cohort evidence: the expert-gold ceiling arm differs from market-only by less than its own bootstrap interval spans, on a 19-case validation intersection (not validated at this sample size)

judgement.overall_risk_rationale: The deterministic severity floor is critical, and the Rule channel returned a critical risk level supported by the verified cash_runway risk; no channel supports going below the floor.

key_findings.statement: A critical cash_runway risk was verified with an independently recalculated deterministic calculation based on supplied financial evidence, and the Rule channel's risk level was critical.

Two medium legal risks (material_litigation_compliance and redemption_rights) remain needs_review, with verifier non-verification on litigation closure/pending status and on the redemption-rights holder.
The Model channel is available but uncalibrated, and its strongest driver direction diverges from the verified document risk, leaving that cross-channel disagreement unresolved.

Unresolved: the frozen model's strongest driver decreases risk while the document channel reports verified high/critical document risk, and no document re-retrieval can settle this cross-channel divergence; direction disagreement is carried to this supervisor unsettled.

judgement.final_explanation: All four governed channels are available, but the Rule channel returned a critical risk level and a verified cash-runway calculation of roughly 2.76 months, while the deterministic severity floor is critical. Legal's litigation and redemption risks remain needs_review, business/financial extraction gaps and the model-document divergence are unsettled, and the model score is uncalibrated and cohort-unvalidated. Overall risk is therefore critical, driven by verified financial and rule-channel evidence, with material unresolved legal and extraction uncertainties.
